texts.NIV84: Accept him whose faith is weak, without passing judgment on disputable matters.

texts.NKJV: There are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is, and the other has not yet come. And when he comes, he must continue a short time.
texts.DRB: Five are fallen, one is, and the other is not yet come: and when he is come, he must remain a short time.
texts.ESV: they are also seven kings, five of whom have fallen, one is, the other has not yet come, and when he does come he must remain only a little while.

texts.NIV84: The beast who once was, and now is not, is an eighth king. He belongs to the seven and is going to his destruction.
texts.KJV: And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goeth into perdition.
texts.NASB95: The beast which was and is not, is himself also an eighth and is one of the seven, and he goes to destruction.
texts.NKJV: The beast that was, and is not, is himself also the eighth, and is of the seven, and is going to perdition.
texts.DRB: And the beast which was, and is not: the same also is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goeth into destruction.
texts.ESV: As for the beast that was and is not, it is an eighth but it belongs to the seven, and it goes to destruction.
texts.LEB: And the beast that was, and is not, is also himself an eighth, and is of the seven, and he is going to destruction.

texts.NIV84: "The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but who for one hour will receive authority as kings along with the beast.

texts.NASB95: The ten horns which you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but they receive authority as kings with the beast for one hour.
texts.NKJV: “The ten horns which you saw are ten kings who have received no kingdom as yet, but they receive authority for one hour as kings with the beast.

texts.ESV: And the ten horns that you saw are ten kings who have not yet received royal power, but they are to receive authority as kings for one hour, together with the beast.
texts.LEB: And the ten horns that you saw are ten kings, who have not yet received a kingdom, but they will receive authority as kings for one hour with the beast.
